        }
    }

    k = min(k, n);

    }

    f[0] = 1.0;
    for (int c = 0; c < k; ++c) {
        const vector<int>& masks = by_count[c];
        for (size_t idx = 0; idx < masks.size(); ++idx) {
            int t = masks[idx];

            double total = 0.0;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if ((t & (1 << j)) == 0) total += p[j];
            }

            double q = f[t] * 1.0 / total;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if ((t & (1 << j)) == 0) f[t | (1 << j)] += p[j] * q;
            }

    }
